IT Security Advisory - SEC-2026560

Date: 2026-11-02 | Severity: CRITICAL | Status: Monitoring
Affected: API Gateway

Summary:
Vulnerability in dependency

Technical Details:
TLS 1.0 still enabled on legacy endpoint

Impact:
Service disruption risk

Required Actions:
1. Enable TLS 1.2+ (Owner: Security Team, Due: 2026-08-19)
2. Rotate affected credentials (Owner: Backend Team, Due: 2026-05-11)
3. Monitor for anomalies (Owner: Platform Team, Due: 2026-02-18)

Workaround:
Disable feature temporarily

References:
- CVE-2026-37221
- Internal ticket: SEC-9025

Contact: security@company.internal | #security-alerts on Slack
